item.title: CAMPUSES DENIED EARLY VOTING SITES ON THREE NC UNIVERSITY CAMPUSES
item.description: Students at three North Carolina universities who had gone to court to get early voting sites on their campuses will likely not have any during this primary election, after a federal district court judge ruled against them on Sunday. item.title: HENDERSONVILLE MARKS LAUNCH OF THE FRENCH BROAD RIVER INTAKE AND WATER TREATMENT FACILITY FILTER EXPANSION WITH FIRST SIP CEREMONY
item.description: Hendersonville City Council members, utility staff, and stakeholders took part in a ‘First Sip’ ceremony to celebrate the completion of the French Broad River Intake and Water Treatment Facility Filter Expansion on February 13, 2026. The French Broad River Intake and Pumping Station provides an additional, redundant source of water to residents and businesses in Hendersonville and Henderson County. item.title: UNC PARDEE LIFTS AGE BASED RESTRICTIONS BUT MASKS STILL REQUIRED
item.description: UNC Health Pardee in Hendersonville announced on Feb. 16 that it is lifting its age-based visitor restrictions that it had in place due to a rise in respiratory illnesses. The hospital said in a news release that masks are still required at the Pardee Hospital Emergency Department and at Pardee Urgent Care locations due to the ongoing circulation of measles in the region.
